mentions.name: Medical Progress Note Rewriter
mentions.description: This web app automatically rewrites complicated and verbose medical progress notes for doctors, NPs, and PAs. It is entirely self-service without needing EHR integrations, persists and reuses the user's writing style without saving any notes, and is HIPAA compliant.
mentions.problem: The amount of time medical providers spend on documentation is ballooning, and only a small portion of that time is actually spent doing medical decision making; the rest is spent copy editing data coming in from imaging, bloodwork, and consultant advice.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a web app that doctors/NPs/PAs can use to automatically rewrite complicated and verbose medical progress notes.
